Package arztis.econnector.common.utilities

Class HttpConstants

java.lang.Object
arztis.econnector.common.utilities.HttpConstants
public class HttpConstants extends Object
Constants for HTTP usage like
  • media types (text/xml, application/xml, text/html, ...)
  • HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE)
  • protocols
